With  Interim Relief Application (IA) No.1 of 2024  Hon'ble Ravindra Maithani, J.
Mr. Shubhr Rastogi, Advocate for the revisionist.
Mr. Pramod Tiwari, Brief Holder for the State.

The challenge in this revision is made to the order dated 29.11.2024, passed in Special Sessions Trial No.97 of 2024, State vs. Shahanawaaj, by the court of FTSC/Additional Sessions Judge, Roorkee,
District Haridwar on an application under Section 319 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 ("the Code") by which, the revisionist has been summoned to answer the accusation under Sections 254-C and 376-D IPC.

District Haridwar
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the revisionist would submit that the FIR is lodged against the revisionist and the co- accused; the charge-sheet was submitted against the co-accused only and the Investigating Officer has found that the revisionist as not involved in the case and the co-accused was in romantic relationship with the victim; during trial, after examination of the victim, an application under Section 319 of the Code filed by the prosecution has been allowed.

Learned counsel for the revisionist would submit that the revisionist was not involved in the case;
during investigation, the Investigating Officer has exonerated him.
He would submit that post filing of the charge-sheet also, the victim was talking to the co-accused and there, she has admitted that she has falsely implicated the revisionist and the co-accused.
What has happened after filing of the charge-sheet may not be relevant, but the fact remains that after investigation, the Investigating Officer has exonerated the revisionist.
Having considered this and other attending factors, this Court is of the view that this matter requires deliberation.
Issue notice to the respondent no.2.
Till the next date of listing, the effect and operation of the impugned order shall remain in abeyance.
